kashika: वेञ इत्यनुवर्तते। ल्यपि च परतो वेञः संप्रसारणं न भवति। प्रवाय। उपवाय। पृथग्योगकरणमुत्तरार्थम्॥
kashikaEnglish: Roots don't undergo संप्रसारण when आत्-substitution applies: पुंवत् forms in feminine: कारीषगन्ध्या remains.
englishFull:
ल्यपि च — The semivowel of वेञ् is not vocalized when ल्यप् follows.

Examples:
- प्रवाय — having woven forth
- उपवाय — having woven near

@note[This sūtra is separated from the previous for subsequent sūtras where only ल्यप्'s anuvrtti runs.]
